body:
PR #2824 opened for TASK-1945 S2 (head-change supersede), head 5d1cf7f704d7d6cafe7b006ede097a01c7d3ef87, branch claude/task-1945-s2.

It implements the signed SKETCH S2 v1 plus C1–C5. Production code is in review_watch.rs (phases, receipt, state machine) and the new review_watch_signal.rs (pidfd verify-and-signal, /proc group scan, Linux-gated). The hold cause shows in capacity_holders and in `aida ps` (human, TOON and --json `review_watch_held`). The doc change is in docs/cli/06-roles-sessions.md.

Tests: sketch tests 1–14, plus C1 ENOSYS, C2 guard, C3 start order, C4 visibility and a head-returns case. All of them run through the C2 test-signal guard.

Two additions beyond the sketch text:
(a) A superseding attempt is driven to Superseded even if the head moves back to it, or the change closes. Otherwise its slot would be held forever.
(b) round_for and reviewer_launch_context now require Reserved/Running, not "active", so Superseding never passes a launch check.

Gates: targeted review_watch tests 58/58, make check-ci-fast 34/34, test-touched pass, check-ci-compile pass. No full suite.

One unrelated flake to note: tests/test_release_skip_ai_warnings.sh Test 3 failed once and passed on rerun. Its `echo "$output_bad" | grep -q` pipe can fail under pipefail when grep exits early and echo gets SIGPIPE.

C5: no lease, worktree or verdict changes, and the dead-PID reviewer-lease relaunch was not exercised in this PR. Not shipped, merged or self-approved. TASK-1945 stays InProgress for S3.
subject: PR opened (TASK-1945 S2)
